Britta tweet accusing Candace of posting fake group-chat screenshots to back her narrative
Morgan Ariel tweet observing that Laura Loomer had not posted about Candace's text reporting
Laura Loomer tweet dismissing Candace's reporting as "postpartum psychotic rants"

The Quartering tweet asking what the texts actually prove, if real

artifacts.bundle_name: Andrew Kolvet – Charlie Kirk Show Audio (2025-10-07)

sub_items.description: Kolvet confirms the text-message screen grab is authentic ("a text grab…that I had shared with people. So it is authentic")
Kolvet states he shared the screen grab with "some people in government" within the first 33 hours and "didn't know where it went from there"
Blake (Charlie Kirk Show co-host) states he is an eyewitness to events and has been advised not to comment publicly
Kolvet describes Charlie's feelings about Israel as "complicated," "nuanced," and a "wrestle that was going on for months," located between the BB Netanyahu letter and the text chain

O'Neill questions the right-to-left shirt movement as inconsistent with his experience shooting people
O'Neill states the crime scene was torn down and "paved over"

artifacts.bundle_name: John and Irina Mappin Public Letter (read on air)

Josh Hammer, on a show the day before the episode, describes a Zoom call with Charlie Kirk the night before Kirk's death, calls Charlie a "close friend," and discusses messaging for Kirk's campus tour and his book "Israel and Civilization"

artifacts.bundle_name: Candace Owens Episode 16 Verbal Testimonial Bundle

Candace states a vetted tip reports George Zinn told multiple nurses/doctors he did the Kirk event because he was being paid to, had not yet been paid, and did not know who would pay him
Candace states a tip indicates George Zinn has potential familial connections to a federal department
Text chain from 2023 between the host and her then-producer, shown on air as proof of a vivid dream
X post by Ashton Forbes (shown with a reply by Mel) saying Candace has no credibility, calling Telegram chats scams and calling her audience a cult
X post by Nick Fuentes saying Kirk had no choice but to lead the pro-Israel cause after a Jewish donor stopped giving millions
Audio of Josh Hammer on a show describing Kirk's letter to Netanyahu and reading its opening line
Host verbal reference to the package of messages and documents she sent to trusted people (not shown)
Viewer comment from Jennifer asking about the security team, drones and drill run-through
Viewer comment from Maheen Sadiki about the term Judeo-Christian
Host verbal reference to her decentralized 'CIA' network of viewers (verbal call to join)

claims.label: Kolvet confirmed text chain authentic
claims.claim: Turning Point USA spokesperson Andrew Kolvet, on the Charlie Kirk Show, confirmed the text-message screen grab released by Candace Owens is authentic and was originally shared by him with others.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Charlie Kirk Show segment audio/video; cross-reference Kolvet's stated timeline of sharing with "people in government" against any subsequent investigative filings.

claims.label: Kolvet shared screen grab with government figures within 33 hours
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated he shared the text-message screen grab with "a few people in government" within the first 33 hours after Kirk's death, before the suspect was publicly identified.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which government figures received the screen grab; determine whether any chain-of-custody record exists for the shared image.

claims.label: Kolvet describes Kirk's Israel position as complicated / ongoing wrestle
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet characterized Kirk's feelings about Israel as "complicated" and "nuanced," stating a "wrestle" had been ongoing for months, located between the BB Netanyahu letter and the text chain.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kolvet's "wrestle" framing against contemporaneous private communications from Kirk to determine the duration and scope of the position shift.

claims.label: Blake (Charlie Kirk Show co-host) identifies as eyewitness
claims.claim: Blake, co-host of the Charlie Kirk Show, publicly identified himself as an eyewitness to events and stated he had been advised not to comment publicly to avoid compromising any trial.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the events Blake claims to have witnessed; determine the source of the legal advice restraining his commentary.

claims.label: O'Neill identifies visible wound as exit wound
claims.claim: Former Navy SEAL Robert J. O'Neill, on the Piers Morgan Show, stated the wound visible in the Charlie Kirk video appeared to be an exit wound rather than an entry wound.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited Kirk video and a forensic pathologist review to determine wound entry/exit characteristics independently of O'Neill's lay assessment.

claims.label: O'Neill questions right-to-left shirt movement
claims.claim: Robert J. O'Neill questioned why Kirk's shirt moved the way it did and why it moved right to left, saying the shirts of people he had shot did not move like that.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited video and forensic-physics reconstruction of the shirt movement to test whether the directionality is consistent with the stated shooter location.

claims.label: O'Neill states crime scene was torn down and paved over
claims.claim: Robert J. O'Neill asked whether the crime scene was torn down immediately, and said the whole crime scene is now gone, that they "paved over it," with nothing to see.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm with Utah court / Utah State Records the timeline of any paving work at the UVU Losee Center site and the responsible party.

claims.label: Britta publicly accused Candace of fabricating group-chat screenshots
claims.claim: A user identified as Britta publicly asked whether Candace Owens is posting fake group-chat screenshots to conveniently back up her narrative.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the Britta accusation against the Kolvet confirmation (C-1380) to determine whether Britta publicly retracted or updated her position.

claims.label: Laura Loomer dismissed Candace's reporting as postpartum psychotic rants
claims.claim: Laura Loomer publicly dismissed Candace Owens's text-messages reporting as "postpartum psychotic rants" and stated that even if the texts are real, it does not mean Israel killed Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Track whether Loomer issued any post-Kolvet-confirmation update acknowledging the texts' authenticity.

claims.label: Nick Fuentes questioned four-week delay in text release
claims.claim: Nick Fuentes publicly questioned why Candace Owens sat on the text messages for four weeks before releasing them.
claims.investigative_direction: Determine the actual interval between Candace's receipt and release of the text chain.

claims.label: The Quartering questioned what the texts prove
claims.claim: Per a post by The Quartering that the host reads, he publicly asked, assuming the released texts are real, what they actually prove beyond the fact that someone close to Kirk leaked them.
claims.investigative_direction: Evaluate the substance of the "what does it prove" critique against the substantive content of the text chain (C-1382, N-14).

claims.label: Community Notes confirmed Kolvet's screen-grab confirmation
claims.claim: Per the Misfit Patriot tweet displayed, Community Notes added an update stating Andrew Kolvet confirmed the screen grab was real.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Community Notes entry directly for the source post to verify the wording of the Kolvet-attributed confirmation.

claims.label: Mappins published public letter supporting Candace's investigation
claims.claim: TPUSA donors John and Irina Mappin published a public letter supporting Candace Owens's investigation into Kirk's death and stating Candace's actions are what Charlie himself would have taken.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Mappin letter publication (URL / date) and any subsequent public reaction from TPUSA leadership.

claims.label: Mappin letter: senior Republicans and TPUSA donors privately agree but fear speaking
claims.claim: The Mappin letter states the Mappins have been receiving calls from senior Republicans and Turning Point donors who agree with Candace but are "terrified to voice their views publicly."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify (with Mappin cooperation) any of the named senior Republican or TPUSA donor callers willing to go on record.

claims.label: Mappin letter: few believe official version
claims.claim: The Mappin letter states "few people following the matter believe the official version" and that a "low minority believe that the current suspect is guilty."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference polling or independent survey data on public belief about the official Kirk investigation narrative.

claims.label: Mappin letter: Mappins helped facilitate Turning Point UK
claims.claim: Candace says the donor, John Mappin (with his wife), made introductions that unlocked more donations for Kirk, and is the donor Kirk turned to when she said they needed to be in the UK; he could have an event set up to start Turning Point UK, which was where she first laid eyes on George (her husband).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through TPUSA / Turning Point UK records John Mappin's role in the UK launch.

claims.label: Flynn / Carlson discussed Pontius Pilate's wife as prophetic dreamer
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, writer/producer Conrad Flynn appears on Tucker Carlson's show and discusses the figure of Pontius Pilate's wife as a prophetic dreamer, with Carlson recounting his own wife's intuition about guests.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Tucker / Flynn segment to determine the surrounding context and any explicit connection drawn to the Kirk case.

claims.label: Josh Hammer claimed Zoom call with Kirk night before death
claims.claim: Josh Hammer, on a show the day before the episode, publicly claimed he spoke with Charlie Kirk on a Zoom call the night before Kirk's death, alongside "a couple others," and that they discussed messaging for Kirk's campus tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the other Zoom call attendees; obtain any contemporaneous notes or call logs; verify whether the call occurred.

claims.label: Three unnamed people told Candace Charlie predicted his own death
claims.claim: Candace Owens states three unnamed people (two with written communication, one a TPUSA donor) told her that Charlie Kirk expressed "I think they're going to kill me" the day before his death.
claims.investigative_direction: Encourage the named tipsters to come forward publicly; cross-reference against A-1233.1 (Frank Turek) and any other contemporaneous sources for Kirk premonition statements.

claims.label: Frank Turek reported Kirk said "they want him dead"
claims.claim: Per a Luna fan comment on the episode, Dr. Frank Turek reported on his podcast that Charlie Kirk, in a conversation about upping his security, said "they want him dead."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and timestamp the Frank Turek podcast episode containing the statement; obtain the original audio.

claims.label: Lance Twiggs was raided but released within 6 hours
claims.claim: Per Lance Twiggs's family (via Candace), Lance was "raided," was "angry about that raid," and was "instantly released back into their care within 6 hours."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain official arrest / detention logs from Utah authorities for Lance Twiggs; reconcile with the family's account.

claims.label: Apartment locks illegally changed after raid
claims.claim: Per Lance's family (via Candace), the locks on the Tyler Robinson / Lance Twiggs apartment were illegally changed after the raid without the family's knowledge or consent.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the party that authorized the lock change (Lance or federal actors); obtain landlord records of the apartment (the family reportedly owns the unit).

claims.label: George Zinn told medical staff he was being paid to claim responsibility
claims.claim: Per a vetted tip relayed by Candace, George Zinn told multiple nurses and doctors that he claimed responsibility for Kirk's death because he was being paid to do so, had not yet been paid, and did not know the source of payment.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify and interview the medical staff who reportedly received these statements from Zinn; obtain any contemporaneous medical records.

claims.label: George Zinn has potential familial connections to a federal department
claims.claim: Per a tip relayed by Candace, George Zinn has potential familial connections to a federal department.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which federal department is implicated; obtain any employment / family records.

claims.label: Host Says Musk Gave X to the Military and Military Bot Farms Push War With Iran
claims.claim: The host says she thinks Elon Musk clearly gave X away to the military, and that users now have to suffer military bot farms calling for war with Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for X ownership or moderation disclosures and bot-network analyses showing military-linked accounts; the host offers no evidence on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think Elon Musk clearly gave it away to the military and we now have to suffer these military bot farms calling for war with Iran.

claims.label: Host Says She Has No Interest in Inheriting Kirk's Turning Point Empire
claims.claim: The host says she has zero interest in Charlie Kirk's empire or in carrying on his torch, contrasting herself with the heirs of the TV show Succession.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with any TPUSA leadership offer or succession discussion naming the host; ask TPUSA whether she was ever approached.
claims.transcript_snippet: I have a 0% interest in Charlie's empire. I am not motivated by the idea of carrying on his torch.

claims.label: Host Shows 2023 Text Chain With Her Then-Producer as Proof of a Prior Vivid Dream
claims.claim: The host says a text chain from 2023 with her then-producer shows she texted that the producer was pregnant before the producer knew, and offers it as an example of a vivid dream coming true.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal matter involving a private individual; nothing to verify for the case beyond the host's own text chain, which she displayed.
claims.transcript_snippet: You texted me June 16th and I think I got pregnant June 26th. This is crazy.

claims.label: Host Says a Weekend Dream Told Her Charlie Was Betrayed
claims.claim: The host says that after a very vivid dream over the weekend she believes Charlie Kirk came to her and told her he was betrayed, though she does not know by whom.
claims.investigative_direction: A dream cannot be checked; compare with the host's later statements naming who she thinks betrayed Kirk and with any witness accounts of Kirk's last days.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie came to me and he told me that he was betrayed.

claims.label: Host Predicts the Truth Will Soon Come Out With International Consequences
claims.claim: The host says she felt in the dream that it is inevitable and soon will be revealed that the truth will come out and that it will have international consequences, and tells viewers to quote her.
claims.investigative_direction: Track whether any named disclosure or document later released by the host or others matches this prediction.
claims.transcript_snippet: it is soon going to be revealed that it's actually inevitable that it is going to be revealed that there is nothing and no one that is going to stop the truth from coming out

claims.label: Host Says She Told Her Husband Through Tears That Charlie Was Betrayed
claims.claim: The host says that almost from the moment she learned Charlie Kirk would not survive, she told her husband George through tears that Kirk had been betrayed.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host when and where she said this; no outside record is expected, so treat as a first-person account.
claims.transcript_snippet: I said to George through tears that he was betrayed.

claims.label: Host Says X Users Made Fake Messages to Argue Her Texts Could Be Faked
claims.claim: The host says that after she released the text message, some X users tried to bargain with reality by creating fake messages themselves to show how easy it is to fake one.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the fake-message posts and compare with Andrew Kolvet's later confirmation that the screen grab was authentic.
claims.transcript_snippet: They were making fake messages themselves.

claims.label: Ashton Forbes Posted That Candace Has No Credibility and Telegram Chats Are Scams
claims.claim: The host reads a post by Ashton Forbes saying Candace Owens has no credibility, that Telegram group chat scams claim to be real people, and that he was briefly in touch with one 'Elon Musk'.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the original Forbes post and its timestamp; check whether he later acknowledged the texts were authenticated by Andrew Kolvet.
claims.transcript_snippet: First off, Candace has no credibility. Second, there's a bunch of Telegram group chat scams that claim to be real people.

claims.label: Ashton Forbes Posted That Even Real Texts Mean Nothing About Charlie's Death
claims.claim: The host reads Ashton Forbes writing that, even if the text messages were real, they mean literally nothing related to Charlie's death, and that doubting the Tyler Robinson texts means these cannot be taken at face value.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the original post; compare with Andrew Kolvet's statement (C-1380 and C-1382) that the chain fits Kirk's known frustrations about Israel.
claims.transcript_snippet: Lastly, even if the text messages were real, they mean literally nothing related to Charlie's death.

claims.label: Ashton Forbes Posted That Candace Is Building a Literal Cult
claims.claim: The host reads Ashton Forbes writing that he finds it scary how Candace Owens is building a literal cult and that followers will soon be drinking Kool-Aid.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the original post and any replies; this is an opinion attributed to Forbes and is recorded only as said.
claims.transcript_snippet: I find it scary how Candace is building a literal cult. Soon they'll be drinking Kool-Aid in sync

claims.label: Host Says Britta Used to Work for Seth Dillon
claims.claim: The host says that Britta, who she says posted asking whether Candace was posting fake group chat screenshots, used to work for Seth Dillon.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Britta's public employment history with Seth Dillon's company; the host says it only as context for her posts.
claims.transcript_snippet: She wrote and by the way she used to work for Seth Dillon.

claims.label: Host Says Laura Loomer Is Legally Not Allowed to Own a Gun
claims.claim: The host says Laura Loomer is legally not allowed to own a gun, and calls her a lunatic.
claims.investigative_direction: Look for court records of any firearm prohibition or involuntary hold concerning Loomer; the host cites none on air.
claims.transcript_snippet: who is legally just, you know, not allowed to own a gun because she's a literal lunatic

claims.label: Loomer Posted That Candace Will Be Sued by TPUSA and Macron's Wife
claims.claim: The host reads a Laura Loomer post saying it will be hilarious when Candace Owens is sued by TPUSA in addition to Macron's wife.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the original Loomer post and check for any TPUSA legal filing against the host; the Macron suit is a separate matter.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's going to be hilarious when she is sued by TPUSA in addition to Macron's wife.

claims.label: Host Says She Called Her Release Week Blitzkrieg Week
claims.claim: The host says she named her run of releases 'Blitzkrieg week' because she was dropping a bunch of bombs, and notes the term is used widely, including by an NFL team.

claims.transcript_snippet: Washington Post certainly does when they're describing things that's happening at the White House.

claims.label: Kolvet Says He Did Not Share the Screen Grab Publicly Because It Was a Private Exchange

claims.label: Kolvet Says He Was Not an Eyewitness and Flew to Utah Immediately

claims.transcript_snippet: Uh it has to do with the broader question of people feeling that Charlie's legacy is intentionally being hijacked by Israel. I never stated that Israel killed Charlie.

claims.label: Host Says an Underground Movement of Truth Tellers Includes Donors and Government Employees
